items.title: DiffGR00T: Execution-Aware Differentiable Training for Humanoid Whole-Body Vision-Language-Action Models
items.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong results in arm-centric manipulation, yet humanoid whole-body control (WBC) requires dynamic balance and tightly coupled full-body coordination. Existing hierarchical humanoid VLAs typically decouple motion generation from physical execution, leaving tracking and balance errors unable to directly optimize the VLA generator. We propose DiffGR00T, an end-to-end differentiable training framework that couples GR00T N1.7 with SONIC, a pretrained whole-body behavior foundation model. To enable execution-aware differentiable training, we replace the non-differentiable simulator with a learned, action-conditioned world model, allowing multi-step body-execution losses to backpropagate through the frozen whole-body controller and the flow-matching sampler directly into the VLA action head. On four HumanoidArena simulation tasks, DiffGR00T improves average task success by 12.5 percentage points over the supervised base VLA (59.2% to 71.7%), demonstrating that execution-aware gradients effectively align high-level motion generation with closed-loop whole-body dynamics.

items.llm_tldr_cn: 现有人形视觉-语言-动作模型多为分层结构，将动作生成与物理执行解耦，导致跟踪与平衡误差无法直接优化生成器。作者提出DiffGR00T端到端可微训练框架，将GR00T与全身行为基础模型SONIC耦合，并用学习到的动作条件世界模型替代不可微仿真器。由此多步身体执行损失可反向传播至VLA生成器，改善全身协调与动态平衡，为执行感知的人形全身控制训练提供可微路径。

items.title: Convex computation of cost bounds for data-driven nonlinear optimal control
items.abstract: The paper addresses the optimal control problem of an input-affine polynomial system with an unknown (state-dependent) input matrix affecting the control effectiveness. Under assumptions on the existence of a data set and the Lipschitz continuity of the unknown part {of the dynamics}, an uncertainty set is constructed and used to adapt the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation towards a data-driven formulation. We solve it for the best-case scenario, thus giving a lower bound on the best cost achievable by means of a feedback control policy. After relaxing it into a moment-SoS hierarchy of semidefinite programs, a control law is extracted from the primal on moments and compared with other benchmark methods in a numerical application.

items.llm_tldr_en: Optimal control of input-affine polynomial systems with unknown input matrices is hard; the paper builds an uncertainty set, adapts the HJB equation and relaxes it via a moment-SoS hierarchy to compute convex lower bounds on achievable cost.
items.llm_tldr_cn: 针对输入矩阵未知的输入仿射多项式系统，最优控制问题难以直接求解。作者构造不确定集并据此改造Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程，得到数据驱动的形式，再通过矩-平方和半定规划层级松弛求取最优代价下界并提取反馈控制律。数值算例验证了该方法并与基准方法进行比较，为数据驱动非线性最优控制提供了凸可解的分析框架。
